It started to rain this am. We haven't seen rain since last spring so we were lovin it. We relaxed all morning since this is the last of the relaxation days. We visited Valerie at her new job. It's in Efig France and she works for a small business that's right up Andy's alley. Her boss was very nice and gave us a tour. There's 21 employees and they do custom work w/ a laser cutter, welding, painting, etc. Andy was so stoked! The boss said Andy could come in a use the equipment- now we only need to move to Europe...

Off to Gabe and Göete's house for dinner. We looked around their kitchen shop to get ideas for ours. Then the family came over for dinner and we had another amazing meal of Italian Antipasti. The cold roast beef in the tuna sauce was really good and went perfectly w/ all the other goodies, olives, peppers, etc. We stayed for a bit after and chatted. Good to spend time w/ family. Back at 1am for our last night.
